page.overview:
Who is S.I.N.?

S.I.N. (Shadaloo Intimidation Network) is the weapons division of the criminal organization of Shadaloo. During Street Fighter IV, the leader and CEO of S.I.N. was Seth, who was likely also constructed as an S.I.N. weapons project. Many people believed at first that S.I.N. was really the remains of the fallen Shadaloo, and not just a division. Guile, Chun-Li and Cammy are all sent to investigate its activities, including the construction of a dam which robs Dhalsim's village of water.

Crimson Viper also spent years masquerading undercover as an S.I.N. operative, rising to become head of the Battle Suit development project. The World Tournament was then used as the final test of the battle suit's capabilities.

Juri eventually confronts and defeats Seth, taking over S.I.N. as its new leader. Meanwhile, S.I.N.'s dam base is eventually destroyed when Vega activates its self-destruct.

It is unknown what remains of the weapons division; however, during the disappearance (and possible fall) of Shadaloo before the events of Street Fighter III, S.I.N. likely went with it.
